column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Ribeira arrival
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Hey, old man! Your hometown really reeks of religion, doesn't it?!
It's a seriously incense-stinking town, isn't it?!
This is where the $$神の鎖$$ that reaches into the sky...
is rooted: the holy city of $$リベイラ$$!
Even so...
That chain's huge no matter how often I see it...!
Looking up at it from right below makes it feel even bigger!!
Believers and $$神官$$s from other countries come and go here all the time,
so it's exceptionally convenient for hiding who we are!
But we're escaped prisoners. There must already be pursuers after us.
And, old man,
if this is your hometown, isn't it only sensible to assume they'll lie in wait here...?!
That's sound reasoning...
Running around won't change a thing.
In $$この世$$, strength is $$正義$$!!
Then we must make them realize that pursuing us is futile.
When it comes to $$おにいちゃん$$, it'll be bam! in one shot! Go, go, go!!
But what exactly are we going to do?
I have some old acquaintances here. With luck, they may lend us some help.
But first we should tidy up our tattered appearances and gather whatever information each of us needs.
Before that... My face is already known, so I'll put on a mask while I can.
